subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should plugin-runtime callers fail closed on all legacy ownerless session rows, even when that breaks an existing patch workflow after upgrade?
rationale: The authorization-order defect is mechanically repairable, but source cannot determine the intended authority and recovery contract for rows created before plugin ownership existed.

options.title: Fail closed with recovery
options.body: Reject ownerless rows while providing an explicit operator or doctor flow to inspect and safely assign or replace ownership.

options.title: Trusted ownership migration
options.body: Migrate eligible rows to an authenticated owner through a narrowly scoped trusted process before enforcing the fence.

recommendation.title: Fail closed with recovery
recommendation.body: Reject ownerless rows while providing an explicit operator or doctor flow to inspect and safely assign or replace ownership.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent combined history across Gateway session behavior and plugin-runtime ownership and are already connected to the PR discussion.
